summary: Iteration 3 — Tested newly added 'forme récente' feature (real recent matches instead of season aggregate). Backend: extended pytest suite from 19 to 23 tests, all pass. Added 4 new tests: POST /api/players/form single (Raphinha 8026 → 8 buts / 3 passes on 6 recent matches, score 100, components sum == score), POST with 8 ids (mix valid/invalid, no 500), POST with invalid id (correctly excluded), GET /api/player/8026 (forme_recente populated). Regression: leaderboard/teams, leaderboard/players, /match/{id}, /scoring/config all still 200. Frontend: opened /match/560578 (Coventry vs Brighton PL), 'Joueurs à surveiller' shows 8 watch cards, each with data-testid player-recent-* line ('X buts et Y passes sur les N derniers matchs') AND clickable player-forme-* score bar that opens the Radix breakdown modal displaying components (Buts+passes / xG+xA). Radar 'Comparaison visuelle' polygon renders correctly. Classements onglet joueurs shows 100 rows, /methodologie exposes 'Scores des joueurs'. No blocking issues.
critical_code_review_comments: player_form.py compute_recent_form correctly normalises c_ga+c_xg to score when raw>100, ensuring composantes.contribution somme == form_score.score (verified ±2 in test).
server.py get_player_form has a 18h Mongo cache in collection player_form with graceful fallback (returns stale data if scrape fails) — good resilience.
server.py POST /api/players/form caps at 12 ids and silently skips ids without data — matches spec.
Frontend PlayerWatchCard renders 'Chargement de la forme récente…' placeholder until form arrives, then swaps to player-recent-* line — verified live on match 560578 (cards populated after ~2-3s).
seed_data_creation: None — used already synced Understat data. Test IDs used: player 8026 (Raphinha), match 560578 (Coventry vs Brighton, PL).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoint POST /api/players/form fully covered by 3 pytest tests (single, multiple, invalid id). GET /api/player/{id} now includes non-null forme_recente (covered). Frontend selectors for the new feature: player-recent-{slug} (line with recent buts/passes) and player-forme-{slug} (score bar opening Radix breakdown). First open of a match may take ~5s while /players/form scrapes+caches 8 players; subsequent visits are instant (18h cache). Raphinha real numbers: 8 buts, 3 passes, 486 min sur 6 derniers matchs, score=100.
